name: P3 Grand Open - March 2017

venue.name: SRR Heights
venue.address: 87, KVR Paradise Colony Rd, Bowrampet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500090

information:
Partipants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 26th March 2017 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 24th March 2017 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 24th March 2017 9:00pm IST.
Please note once you register in WCA site for the event P3 GRAND OPEN - March 2017, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. Your name will be rejected if there is a failure in payment within 2 days of your event registration in WCA site. If your name is not showing in competitors list in WCA site under the P3 Grand Open - March 2017 event, you will not be allowed to participate.
